selection_policy: Accuracy screen: every sampled Frobenius and max-absolute component no worse, at least one improves; fastest accuracy-eligible pilot method. Speed: >=10% lower median, paired five-block 95% bootstrap interval above 1, p95 no worse. Strongest control selected conservatively by held-out median.
limits: One constructed asymmetric graph family with geometrically decaying constructed coefficients
Full FP64 CPU reference checks for every output; 384-bit truth checks on first 16 rows, not all vertices
Resident validated-input compute; excludes I/O, finite-state checks and compilation/JIT
Profile selection is reconstructed from recorded pilots; policy and wide follow-up were developed after exploratory results
No current native-cuGraph PageRank comparison, broad ranking rerun, customer savings or global SOTA claim
